_: The row-level dimensions. A rule (admin console) lists the values of one dimension a person or group may see; cube.js adds `member in values` to every query that touches one of `cubes`. Different dimensions are ANDed, the values of one are ORed. This file is the source: auth/ and admin/ keep identical copies (a test checks it, and that each member is reachable from each cube). `when_empty`: deny = a person with no value gets nothing from those cubes, allow = no value means no restriction. `values`: seed_regions = the territories of the dbt seed, list = the fixed values given, cube = the distinct values of the member.
